title: Keeb Quest: Typing Battles
description:
Keeb Quest is a typing game that turns practice into an adventure. Every key press matters, whether you're battling bosses, exploring branching stories, or drilling words you struggle to type. Build speed, accuracy, and confidence, then watch yourself improve over time.
 

 Designed Around Typing, Nothing ElseNo currency to grind, no ability rotations to memorize, and no stats to manage except the ones that matter: speed and accuracy. Every word on screen is a real word, so what you practice here transfers directly to typing anywhere else. And you're never typing blind: the upcoming word is always visible, training the same look-ahead rhythm that separates fast typists from slow ones. Every design decision serves one goal: helping you become a better typist.

Features and Game ModesCampaign Mode

Progress through a map of battles toward the final boss. Your HP carries across each run, making every fight count. Unlock harder tiers and push your typing skills further.
 
 Endless Mode

Fight through escalating waves of enemies. Every five rounds, battle a boss. Runs last around 8-12 minutes. 
 
Boss Survival

Endless challenges across five boss types: Paragraph, Falling Words, Word Grid, Dialogue, and Line Rush.

Adventure Mode

A relaxed, no-pressure mode where you type through branching stories. Choose your path and discover multiple endings at your own pace. 

Academy

A complete 140-lesson curriculum that teaches you touch typing from beginning to end. Take on challenge lessons and chapter bosses to put your skills to the test.

Track Your ProgressPer-key heatmaps, WPM curves, accuracy grades, high scores, and achievements. Review session history to spot trends, identify weak keys, and watch your speed climb over time. Compete on leaderboards against friends and the global player base.

Why I Made This GameI've always had a love for keyboards and typing. As a kid, I first learned to type through playing MUDs and chatting away on IRC. It's always been a passion of mine, to the point that I choose my vacation destinations based on the available mechanical keyboard shops in the area. A nice Sunday morning to me is cleaning and rotating out my keycaps to avoid them getting any sheen. My keyboard of choice is a low-profile tenkeyless with tactile switches. This game is a passion project resulting from my love of the hobby, and I hope you enjoy it!

Battle enemies and bosses, explore branching stories, and watch yourself get faster and more accurate with every run.
